scoring: Each conjunct in each mandatory predicate must be established. Extra audit sections cannot retroactively repair frozen citation packages. Current provider facts and original citation sufficiency are separate.
original_opened_complete_definition: All mandatory predicates supported by the original opened evidence package, not by extra audit-only sections.
audit_opened_complete_definition: All mandatory predicates supported after independent audit opens.
cited_complete_definition: All mandatory predicates supported within the original returned citation sections.
novelty_rule: Question-specific initial explicit names; shared ecosystem does not make every separately named product known. Known concept versus new target is recorded separately.
